Record Class CrystalCell

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.api.CrystalCell
Record Components:
a - the length of lattice vector a in angstroms
b - the length of lattice vector b in angstroms
c - the length of lattice vector c in angstroms
alpha - the angle alpha in degrees
beta - the angle beta in degrees
gamma - the angle gamma in degrees
originX - the Cartesian x-coordinate of the origin
originY - the Cartesian y-coordinate of the origin
originZ - the Cartesian z-coordinate of the origin
public record CrystalCell(double a, double b, double c, double alpha, double beta, double gamma, double originX, double originY, double originZ) extends Record
The size and shape of one repeating block of a crystal.

Lengths are in angstroms and angles are in degrees. The origin gives the block's position relative to the atom coordinates. Repeating this block creates the crystal preview.

      public CrystalCell(double a, double b, double c, double alpha, double beta, double gamma, double originX, double originY, double originZ)
